source.title: Avoid applying the same discount twice

input.diff_text:
diff --git a/src/checkout.py b/src/checkout.py
--- a/src/checkout.py
+++ b/src/checkout.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 from .discounts import apply_discount
 
 def checkout(total, rate):
-    return apply_discount(total, rate)
+    return apply_discount(total, rate) - total * rate

files.src/discounts.py:
def apply_discount(total, rate):
    return total - total * rate

issues.description: checkout subtracts the discount a second time after apply_discount already did so
issues.repair_unit: remove duplicate discount subtraction at the checkout helper boundary
